name: Full communication strategy
prompt: Build a market communication strategy for our product.
expected_behavior: Reads .agents/<productname>/product.md for brand, audience, and positioning
Researches competitor communications and real audience language first
Presents a brief and asks which stakeholders matter and what's driving the request
Produces a single core message with 2-3 pillars and proof points
Builds StoryBrand SB7 with the customer as hero and brand as guide
References communication-frameworks.md

name: Message map with single core message
prompt: Give us our core message and supporting pillars.
expected_behavior: Defines exactly ONE core message, not several competing taglines
Creates 2-3 pillars each with at least two proof points
Ensures every planned asset traces back to a pillar
Uses audience-verbatim language where possible

name: Stakeholder message sheets
prompt: How should we talk to parents vs schools vs students?
expected_behavior: Builds a distinct message sheet per stakeholder
Specifies concern, message, tone, proof point, CTA, and what NOT to say
Keeps the customer as the hero, brand as guide
Selects the right channel for each stakeholder

name: PESO channel plan
prompt: Plan our communication channels across paid, earned, shared, and owned.
expected_behavior: Covers all four PESO types with a clear role for each
Assigns frequency, format, audience, and KPI per channel
Avoids over-reliance on paid alone
Maps channels back to the message pillars

name: Crisis communication protocol
prompt: We're getting negative press — what's our communication response?
expected_behavior: Applies the DEARE protocol (Detect, Evaluate, Acknowledge, Respond, Evolve)
Classifies the issue into a severity tier with a time-bound response window
Provides a holding-statement template for the first 1-2 hours
Recommends a post-crisis review and protocol update
